name: Testimonials
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site testimonial sections, in the layouts of the Untitled UI testimonial sections the marketing team picked (layout only; no Untitled UI photo or asset): Simple centred (3), Simple left aligned, Split image (3), Card, Card split image, Case study cards and Abstract image. Every placeholder is a real image file; every value comes from a DS token, component or marketing section (Cards, Features, Logos), and what the DS does not yet define is listed under Composed of as missing. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Eleven layouts, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet

Every placeholder (customer photos, split photo, collage, case study covers) is an pointing at a real image file with alt text, and every avatar is with a photo src, never a drawn box or initials; the files and their sources are listed in marketing/images/testimonials/manifest.json

Rating is <aha-rate readonly size="sm">, avatars are <aha-avatar> (default 40, large 64), arrows are <aha-button variant="secondary" icon-only>; quote, name and role styles are the Testimonial card of the Cards page, the case study cards are its Case study card, and the section frame, header block and photo ratios are the Features section's

Carousel layouts are a native scroll-snap track with the DS secondary icon-only button for arrows and the Carousel dot values (16 by 4 rest dot in grey 70, 28 wide Vivid Pink active dot, gap 8); no autoplay, the track is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys, and the small script only moves the track

Company logos are trimmed copies of the Logos section data (marketing/data/logos-cms.json), kept in greyscale, all rendered at one fixed height with width auto, so every logo shares the same left edge and optical size
Each section is a container-query block stepping down at 991, 767 and 479px, with the Features section padding at each step

composedOf.use: Previous and next arrows: variant secondary, icon-only, size md
Customer photo avatars: size default (40) and large (64)
Star rating: readonly, size sm (16px stars, gap 2)
Testimonial card type (quote, name, role, person row) and Case study card anatomy (cover 3:2, body, stretched link, hover lift)
Section frame (1280 wide, padding 96/64, 48/24, 32/16), header block, split grid, photo ratios
Greyscale logo treatment and logo row gap
Dot size, gap, rest and active colours
Scroll-snap track, track-to-dots gap and dot hit area (DSN-956)
Single logo above a quote or in a card, 32px stand-in (DSN-958)
Name, role and rating card over the Split image 01 photo (DSN-959)
Cards Testimonial card 44px avatar against aha-avatar 40/64 (DSN-963)
